#Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for Quartermaster (QM)
[italic]Below outlines expectations and permissions granted to a QM given the current alert level:[/italic]
[bold][color=green] Code Green [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] The QM is responsible for making sure no security items are ordered except by security staff. The QM may order security items as long as they are delivered directly to security immediately after pickup
[bold]2.[/bold] The QM may delegating pickup and delivery of security items, but the QM should know who is picking up the items and stay up to date on the progress of the delivery
[bold]3.[/bold] The QM is responsible for providing materials (Mats) [italic]example: (Steel, Glass, and Plastic)[/italic]. This includes making sure that salvaged materials are distributed amongst all departments.
[bold]4.[/bold] The QM is responsible for ensuring that confirmed orders reach their intended recipient within 15 minutes of the order arriving on the Automated Trade Station
[bold][color=blue] Code Blue [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] All guidelines carry over from Code Green.
[bold][color=RED] Code Red [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] All guidelines carry over from Code Blue.
[bold]2.[/bold] The QM is permitted to take their staff off station to the ATS and halt typical cargo operations. Preforming rescue operations utilizing cargo's shuttles is suggested given an appropriate station threat.
